title: claude-cli-pin workflow fails on re-run while its bump PR is open
description:
Each run makes a fresh commit on chore/claude-cli-pin-<ver> and runs a plain git push -u. If last week's PR for the same version is still open, the remote branch exists with a different commit, so the push is rejected as non-fast-forward and the job goes red before the 'already open' check runs.
evidence: .github/workflows/claude-cli-pin.yml 'Open the bump PR' step
